name: One-Phase Remapping Model
definition: A method to solve the remapping problem in parallel direct volume rendering (DVR) by constructing a single augmented graph (remapping graph) and performing a single K-way partition, rather than separating partitioning and assignment into two phases.
summary: The One-Phase Remapping Model solves parallel volume rendering by constructing a single augmented graph to simultaneously optimize load balance and migration costs, avoiding the quality restrictions of traditional two-phase approaches.
